## Modules

- [Nerves.Artifact](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Nerves.Artifact.md): Package artifacts are the product of compiling a package with a
specific toolchain.

- [Nerves.Artifact.BuildRunner](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Nerves.Artifact.BuildRunner.md): Defines the Nerves build runner behaviour
- [Nerves.Artifact.BuildRunners.Docker](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Nerves.Artifact.BuildRunners.Docker.md): Produce an artifact for a package using Docker.
- [Nerves.Artifact.BuildRunners.Local](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Nerves.Artifact.BuildRunners.Local.md): Builds an artifact locally.
- [Nerves.Artifact.Resolvers.URI](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Nerves.Artifact.Resolvers.URI.md): Downloads an artifact from a remote http location.

- [Nerves.Env](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Nerves.Env.md): Contains package info for Nerves dependencies
- [Nerves.Erlinit](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Nerves.Erlinit.md): Decode and encode erlinit.config files
- [Nerves.Package](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Nerves.Package.md): Defines a Nerves package struct and helper functions.
- [Nerves.Package.Platform](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Nerves.Package.Platform.md): Defines the Nerves package platform behaviour
- [Nerves.Port](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Nerves.Port.md): The code from this file was copied in from MuonTrap
https://github.com/fhunleth/muontrap

- [Nerves.System.BR](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Nerves.System.BR.md): Package builder for Buildroot-based Nerves systems

- [Nerves.Utils.WSL](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Nerves.Utils.WSL.md): This module contains utility functions to assist in detecting a Windows
Subsystem for Linux environment as well as functions to convert paths between
the Windows host and Linux.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix burn](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Burn.md): Writes the generated firmware image to an attached SDCard or file.
- [mix compile.nerves_package](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Compile.NervesPackage.md): Compile a Nerves package into a local artifact
- [mix firmware](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Firmware.md): Build a firmware image for the selected target platform.
- [mix firmware.burn](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Firmware.Burn.md): This task calls `mix firmware` & `mix burn` to burn a new firmware to a SDCard
- [mix firmware.gen.gdb](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Firmware.Gen.Gdb.md): Generates a helper shell script for using gdb to analyze core dumps
- [mix firmware.image](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Firmware.Image.md): Create a firmware image file that can be copied byte-for-byte to an SDCard
or other memory device.
- [mix firmware.metadata](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Firmware.Metadata.md): This task calls `fwup` to report the firmware stored in the currently built
firmware bundle. No firmware is built, so this task will fail if the firmware
bundle doesn't exist.
- [mix firmware.patch](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Firmware.Patch.md): Generate a firmware patch from a source and target firmware and output a new
firmware file with the patch contents. The source firmware file
- [mix firmware.unpack](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Firmware.Unpack.md): Unpack the firmware so that its contents can be inspected locally.
- [mix nerves.artifact](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Nerves.Artifact.md): Creates a Nerves artifact for a Nerves system or toolchain
- [mix nerves.artifact.details](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Nerves.Artifact.Details.md): Prints Nerves artifact details.
- [mix nerves.clean](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Nerves.Clean.md): Cleans dependencies and build artifacts
- [mix nerves.discover](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Nerves.Discover.md): Discover Nerves devices on the local network using mDNS
- [mix nerves.info](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Nerves.Info.md): Prints Nerves system information.
- [mix nerves.system.shell](https://nerves.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Nerves.System.Shell.md): Open a shell in a system's build directory.
